findings.result: Mild paraspinal muscle tenderness in the lower back on both sides; range of motion within normal limits; no warmth or redness.

findings.result: Not tender; normal range of motion on both sides.

findings.result: Popliteal, dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses 2+ on both sides.

findings.name: motor strength
findings.result: 5/5 throughout, including left great toe dorsiflexion; normal strength in both legs.

findings.name: reflexes
findings.result: Deep tendon reflexes 2+ and symmetric; normal in both legs.

findings.name: gait
findings.result: Normal, including toe-to-heel walking, but he walks with his back slightly bent forward.

other_considerations.note: Often follows strenuous or unusual exertion with paraspinal tenderness, but the pain usually does not radiate to the extremities.
Common; pain is typically worse with activity and better with rest, and radicular symptoms may be present.
Patients are typically over 50 and back or bone pain may be the only complaint; anemia, neuropathy, hypercalcemia and renal failure are also common.
Intentional faking of symptoms for secondary gain, such as getting out of work.

source_issues: e006: 'Babinski sign bilaterally' gives no direction (upgoing/downgoing); recorded as 'Result not documented' with a flag (x011). The SP is told to show normal reflexes.
e006: 'Straight leg raising is 80 degrees bilaterally' does not say whether the maneuver reproduced pain; the angle is kept and the missing pain response is flagged (x014).
e002 'VS: Within Normal Limits' disagrees with the doorway heart rate of 50/minute (below the usual normal range).
Alcohol: script says 'a few beers on the weekends'; the note says '1-2 beers on weekends'.
Note SH says 'CAGE 0/4', but the script asks only the Cut-down question (p023).

Note HPI says the 1-year intermittent pain 'is relieved by lying down after ambulation'; the script (p016) says it goes away when he stops walking and sits down (gold #2 also says 'resolves with sitting'). The note also says 'worsens with movement' where the script says walking, sitting for a long time and coughing.
Note FH 'Noncontributory', although the script gives father's death from a heart attack at 65.
p024 and p025 questions carry stray quotation marks ('"Have you ever used illegal substances?', '"Do you smoke'') from the raw sheet.
The SP sheet's patient description says he lives with his girlfriend; this is not in any Q/A or the note and has no valid source id.
notes: Per a later policy update (which overrides the GUIDE.md Babinski example wording), env findings carry no review commentary: an undirected Babinski is recorded as 'Result not documented' and the reason is in the record's flags.

The current pain (1 week, after lifting) is 'current'; the year-long on-and-off back and leg pain with walking (p016) is 'recurrent' and kept separate, because the two pains have different triggers and relief.

Urinary straining and incomplete emptying are coded as ROS (not the presenting complaint). The 6-month duration is attached only to straining, as stated; incomplete emptying is 'sometimes' with no duration (the note gives 6 months for both).
'Lives with his girlfriend' is placed in persona.acting_notes as background, because patient facts need a Q/A, cc or note source.
Behavioral SP instructions that describe examinable findings (tenderness, normal neuro findings, forward lean) are merged into the matching exam records (x006, x009, x010, x012, x013).

Conversion: the note's 'VS: WNL' (e002) is cited on the blood pressure, temperature and respiratory rate records, which it agrees with, but not on the heart rate record (50/minute); no 'on recheck' record was made because the note gives no value.
Conversion: ibuprofen's effect on the pain (v1 f023, p017) is a treatment_response child of the back pain (f011); the medication itself is f030.

Conversion: the year-long episodes (p016) are a parent f022 with duration, trigger, accompanying leg pain and relief as children; straining (p011) is a parent f014 with its 6-month duration as a child.
Harmonisation pass: scale [0, 10] added to f005; f027 item -> 'chronic medical problems' (blanket denial).
Fixes: f014 answer word removed; f034 answer word removed; f037 answer word removed; f038 answer word removed; f039 answer word removed.
